subject: dym-f
title: DYM.F.------MT.INFO.
description: Diagram in UPB(II)-31, the third on book p169. DYM-F (dynamic functionalism) is crossed with MT-INFO (multi-information). Besides the main line to MT-INFO, three branches leave the subject: CUL-INFO-F (culture information focus), IST-F-ACT (isolated focus activism), and AF-DY (affinity dynamics). AF-DY carries POST (postulation), which carries CO-FO-ACT (composite focused activism). CO-FO-ACT branches to PR-TRS and to BSCF (basic science, or basic scientific functionalism), and BSCF carries (R)POST (the reality of postulation).
